 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. FC Augsburg and Manuel Baum will be eager to return to winning ways as they face 1.FC Union Berlin side who have shown a recent improvement in form prior to this afternoon.
 With kick-off scheduled in around an hour's time at 15:30 CET, both coaches have announced their starting lineups and you can see all the details below.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed FC Augsburg vs. 1.FC Union Berlin lineups:
 FC Augsburg (3-4-2-1): Dahmen – Bah, Matsima, Brackelmann – Wolf, Massengo, Rieder, Behrens – Ibrahimovic, Kade – Gregoritsch
 1.FC Union Berlin (4-2-2-2): Rønnow – Haberer, Van den Bosch, Uduokhai, Rothe – Schäfer, Khedira – Jeong, Aebischer – Burcu, Skarke
